title: Building a Real Sample

launchpad.outcome: See your real evidence meter and practice milestones, and handle a three-loss streak without rewriting the plan.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Is this enough to conclude anything?

slides.title: Your sample, so far
lines: These milestones are cute. The message under them isn’t. 😂
slides.principle: DON’T MAKE A PERMANENT RULE FROM A TEMPORARY STREAK.

takeaways: 10 · 25 · 50 · 100 are practice milestones, not proof of an edge.
Three reps: learn from them. Don’t conclude from them.
remember: Don’t make a permanent rule from a temporary streak.
